side.name: Side
side.description: Which side of the anchor element to position the popup on.

align.name: Align
align.description: How to align the popup relative to the anchor element.

sideOffset.name: Side Offset
sideOffset.description: The offset of the popup along its side.

alignOffset.name: Align Offset
alignOffset.description: The offset of the popup along its alignment axis.

arrowPadding.name: Arrow Padding
arrowPadding.description: The padding between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

collisionBoundary.name: Collision Boundary
collisionBoundary.description: The boundary to use for collision detection.

collisionPadding.name: Collision Padding
collisionPadding.description: The padding between the popup and the collision boundary.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.description: Whether the popup remains sticky to the viewport edge when it would otherwise overflow.

disableAnchorTracking.name: Disable Anchor Tracking
disableAnchorTracking.description: Whether to disable tracking the anchor element position.

positionMethod.name: Position Method
positionMethod.description: The method used to position the popup.
